_what_this_is: The numbers baseline-0002 measured, kept as evidence and DELIBERATELY NOT KEPT AS A
CARRY-FORWARD. The original file was `reports/baseline-0002.carry-forward.json`; it has been
deleted and its contents are reproduced verbatim below under `sim` and `comfortableStreak`.
WHY IT WAS RETIRED. Re-running baseline-0002's batch reproduces neither its scoring nor its
sack rate: the playbook corpus and the sack-credit dispatches moved the engine after the file
was written. The carry-forward MECHANISM was never at fault — the file simply predates the
changes, and it recorded nothing that could reveal that. A successor pointed at it would have
printed a full column of confident trend arrows measuring the distance to a tree that no
WHY THE FILE WAS RENAMED RATHER THAN LEFT IN PLACE. `src/report/identity.ts` would refuse it
anyway: it carries no `format` tag and no `identity` block, so `decideTrend` returns REFUSED
before reading a single number. But `FF_BASELINE_PREV=reports/baseline-0002.carry-forward.json`
is the obvious next command for anyone who finds the file, and a loaded gun that only misfires
because a guard caught it is still a loaded gun in the drawer. It is now named for what it is:
a superseded record, not a predecessor.
DO NOT PASS THIS FILE TO FF_BASELINE_PREV. It is refused by design and by name.
TO GET A TREND AGAINST baseline-0002: re-run its batch configuration on the current tree with
FF_ENGINE_COMMIT set, and trend against the carry-forward that run writes.
